effects: Takes exactly `assets` frxUSD from the signer and sends it to the vault (enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints sdFRXUSDv2 shares to `onBehalf`. The amount comes from previewDeposit at the current share price and has no minimum.
Spends the signer's existing frxUSD allowance to the vault by `assets`.
formats.shown: Deposit X frxUSD into the vault; sdFRXUSDv2 shares go to the onBehalf address.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown because the vault's share price sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The descriptor shows only a constant 'Share ticker' sdFRXUSDv2. Case 0 minted 1e18 shares to 0xdEaD.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. A label such as 'Receive sdFRXUSDv2 shares (amount set by vault price)' could set expectations.

cases.notes: 1 frxUSD out to the vault is shown exactly. The shares went to 0xdEaD (signer null), and the screen shows that recipient. The reader understood both.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns the sdFRXUSDv2 shares of `onBehalf` (the signer when onBehalf = signer). The amount comes from previewWithdraw and has no maximum.
Sends exactly `assets` frxUSD from the vault to `receiver`.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, spends the shares allowance that onBehalf gave the signer.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly X frxUSD to the receiver, taken from the Owner's position.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is not shown, and the screen never names sdFRXUSDv2.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` → `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. In case 1, 1999.991247 sdFRXUSDv2 left the signer. The screen shows only 'Withdraw exactly 2000 frxUSD' plus To/Owner.
findings.fix: The amount cannot be shown from calldata. A constant field such as 'Shares burned from: sdFRXUSDv2' (vaultTicker), labelled to match the Owner, would name the asset that leaves.

cases.notes: frxUSD in (2000) is shown exactly with the right recipient. The sdFRXUSDv2 burn is not on the screen. The reader inferred it but did not know the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends frxUSD to `receiver`. The amount comes from previewRedeem and has no minimum.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, spends the shares allowance that onBehalf gave the signer.
formats.shown: Redeem X sdFRXUSDv2 shares, with the payout sent to the receiver from the Owner's position. Nothing names the asset paid out.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says the payout is frxUSD, although the descriptor has that constant.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)` with asset = frxUSD (constructor arg). The descriptor fields are only shares/receiver/onBehalf. metadata.constants.underlyingTicker = 'frxUSD' is unused here. In case 2 the signer received 8004.5458 frxUSD, and the reader wrote 'The screen shows no token or amount.'
findings.fix: Add a field such as {label: 'Receive asset', format: raw, value: $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker}. Or name frxUSD in the intent: 'Redeem {#.shares} for frxUSD to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the frxUSD amount received is set by the vault price and has no minimum to show.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. The calldata has no min-out. Case 2 received 8004.545852 frxUSD.

cases.notes: The shares out (7999.96 sdFRXUSDv2) are shown exactly. frxUSD in is not named. The reader guessed 'probably frxUSD-related' and had no amount.
